# Phase 3 — feature selection and collinearity

*Generated by `hydrocascade rootcause` on 2026-09-17.*

> ### ⚠ Fitted on synthetic data
>
> `data_mode` is `synthetic` for `era5_land`, `glofas`, `imd`, `imerg`, and 9,764 of
> 9,765 catalog rows are synthetic stand-ins. **Every number in this report describes
> the stand-in generators, not Kerala.** They are here to show the procedure runs end
> to end and that the diagnostics fire. Switching `data_mode` to `real` and rerunning
> `hydrocascade rootcause` turns all of them into results with no code change.


Doc 06 §3 procedure, in order: drop >20% missing, then |r| > 0.85 keeping the more physically interpretable of each pair, then VIF > 10 iteratively.

**Two covariate families specified by Doc 05 §6 are absent.** SoilGrids (texture, depth, organic carbon) and ESA WorldCover (land cover class and fractions) were not downloaded, so the model is terrain- and rainfall-only. Both are free and login-free; until they are in, soil and land cover cannot appear in any driver ranking, and their absence is a ceiling on achievable skill rather than evidence that they do not matter.
